steps.command:
cat > /tmp/test_issue.py << 'EOF'
import pytest

@pytest.mark.skip
def test_skip_location() -> None:
    assert 0
EOF
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && cd /testbed
pytest -rs /tmp/test_issue.py
echo "---with runxfail---"
pytest -rs --runxfail /tmp/test_issue.py
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && cd /testbed && pytest -rA testing/test_skipping.py 2>&1 | tail -40
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate && conda activate testbed && cd /testbed && pytest -rA testing/test_runner.py testing/test_mark.py 2>&1 | tail -20
